response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS site_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), shares AS (SELECT site_count, 1.0 * site_count / SUM(site_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(sh.site_count) AS average_count, AVG(sh.share) AS average_share, AVG(sh.share - b.avg_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares AS sh CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE sh.share > b.avg_share;
